verdict.rationale: The evidence only says Vue has a "compiler-optimized rendering system" (vue-docs-4). Nothing in the pack shows Vue updates the DOM without a virtual DOM diffing step, which is the core of this story. Compiler optimization alone is a related but different capability, and rendering strategy is a fair axis for a UI framework, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a compiler-optimized rendering system that updates the DOM without a virtual DOM diffing step
